article.title: Acceptance by several drawees not partners.
article.content: Where there are several drawees of a bill of exchange who are not partners, each of them can accept it for himself, but none of them can accept it for another without his authority.
article.html:
34Acceptance by several drawees not partners.

Section 34 · Chapter III · page 13 of the Act

Where there are several drawees of a bill of exchange who are not partners, each of them can accept it for himself, but none of them can accept it for another without his authority.
